d: Jatigat bhedbhav sirph ek samajik samasya nahin, balki hamare desh ki ek karvi hakikat rahi hai. ek aisa samay bhi tha jab keval kisi ek samuday men janm lene bhar se insan bara-chhota, chhut-achhut ho jata tha. us jamane men jinhen kathit taur par nichi jati kaha jata tha, unmen janm lene vale logon ke lie jindgi na to aasan thi aur na hi sammanajnak. usi daur men ek kavi ne kuchh aisi rachnaen likhin jo dil ko tor dene vali hone ke sath-sath prernadayak bhi hain. ve the adam gondvi, ek adbhut kavi. aaj sahity tak par Poetry On Loop ke is episod men sunie adam gondvi ki kavita ‘chamaron…
